v: ARIveya
puMstrI॰ aRirastyasya vA dIrGaH aRIvaH fziBeda stasyApatyam SuBrA॰ Qak । aRIvarzerapatye ।
m: आणीवेय m. a descendant of Aṇīva, (g. शुभ्रादि, q.v.)

s: tri, (aRaka eva svArTe aR .) aRakaH । aDamaH । iti rAyamukuwaH ॥
v: ARaka
tri॰ aRaka eva svArTe aR । 1 aDame kutsite mukuwaH । “ARakaM surataM nAma dampatyoH pArSvasaMsTayoH” ityukta lakzaRe 2 surataBede na॰ ।
m: आणक mfn. = अण्˚, q.v., Vet.
a: आणक — a. [अणक एव स्वार्थे अण्] Low, inferior, vile. --कं Sexual enjoyment in a particular position; आणकं सुरतं नाम दंपत्योः पार्श्वसंस्थयोः ..

s: tri, (aRu + KaY .) aRavyaM । aRuDAnyodBavocitakzetraM । ityamarawIkAyAM rAyamukuwaH ।
v: ARavIna
tri॰ aRuDAnyAnAM SarzapAdInAM BavanaM kzetram vA KaY । (sunAqANgA) kzetraBede kzatra SarzapAdyaRuDAnyAnyutpadyante tasmin । pakze yat aRavyamapyatra ।
m: आणवीन mfn. bearing or fit to bear Panicum Miliaceum, Pāṇ. v, 2, 4.
a: आणवीन — a. [अणुधान्यानां भवनं क्षेत्रं वा खञ्] Bearing or fit to bear Aṇu (Panicum Miliaceum).

v: ARava
na॰ aRorBAvaH pfTvAdi॰ vA aR । aRutve ।
m: आणव mfn. (fr. अणु), fine, minute, Up.
= आणवीन, q.v., L.
आणव n. exceeding smallness, (g. पृथ्व्-आदि, q.v.)
a: आणव — a. (वी f.) Exceedingly small. --वं Exceeding smallness or minuteness.

s: puM, strI, (aRa + in .) akzAgrakIlakaH ॥ aSriH । sImA । iti medinI ॥
v: ARi

puMstrI॰ aRa--iR striyAM vA NIp । raTacakrAgrasTe 1 kIlake, 2 kowO 3 sImni ca । “mayoBuvA saraTA yAtamarvAggantaM niDiM DuramARi rna nABim” f॰ 4, 43, 8 । “ARiM na raTyamamftADitasTuH” f॰ 1, 35, 6, suSrutokte marmmasTAnaBede, ata UrdDvaM praMtyekaSomarmmasTAnaM vyAKyAsyAma” ityupakramya । “jAnuna UrdDvamuBayatastryaNgulamARirnAma tatraSoPABivfdDiH stavDasakTitA ca” ukram ।
m: आणि इस्, m. (cf. अणि) the pin of the axle of a cart, RV. i, 35, 6; 63, 3 [‘battle’, Naigh. ii, 17], and v, 43, 8
the part of the leg just above the knee, Suśr.
आणि इस्, m. f. a linchpin, L.
the corner of a house, L.
a boundary, L.
a: आणिः — m. f. [अण्-इण् स्त्रियां वा ङीप्] 1 The pin of the axle of a cart, the linch-pin. --2 The part of the leg just above the knee (जानुन ऊर्ध्वमुभयतस्त्र्यंगुलमणिर्नाम Suśr.). --3 The corner of a house. --4 A boundary, limit. --5 The edge of a sword.

m: आण्डाद् n. ‘eating eggs’, N. of a demon, AV. viii, 6, 25.

v: ARqAyana
tri॰ aRqena nirvfttaH pakzA॰ Pak । aRqa nirvftte tri॰ ।
m: आण्डायन mfn. fr. अण्ड, (g. पक्षादि.)
आण्डी (आण्ड्यौ), f. du. id., AV. vi, 138, 2.
आण्डीक mfn. bearing eggs (i.e. egg-shaped fruits or bulbs), AV. iv, 34, 5; v, 17, 16; Kauś.

v: ARqIra
pu॰ ARqamastyasya Irac । vfzaRayukte ityapare aRqIra ityeva sADurityanye ।

m: आण्डी-वत् mfn. (g. कर्णादि, q.v.)
आण्डीवतायनि fr. आण्डी-वत् above, (g. कर्णादि, q.v.)

v: ARqIvata
pu॰ rAjaBede । tena nirvfttam kaRvA॰ PiY । ARqIvatAyaniH tannirvftte tri॰ ।
ARqa

tri॰ aRqeBavaH aR । 1 aRqasamBave pakzipraBftO striyAM NIp vede tu kvacit wAp । “ARqeva BittvAM Sakunasya garBam” f॰ 1, 68, 7, 2 aRqajAte hiraRyagarBe pu॰ “tadaRqamaBavadDEmaM sahasrAMSusamapraBam । tasmin jajYe svayaM brahmA sarvvalokapitAmaha” iti manUktestasyARqajAtatvAt taTAtvam । “virAqvahemAvARqO svarAw ca” Sata॰ brA॰ । aRqameva svArTe aR । 3 puruzavfzaResvArTikapratyayasya kvacit liNgavacanAtikramasyezwatvAt pu॰ “yasya hyARqO BavataH retaH siYcati” Sata॰ brA॰ । “AnandanandAmARqO me” yaju॰ 20, 9, “ARqO vfzaRO” vedadI॰ । “aRqaM vfzaRo'styasya aR । 4 vfzaRayukte “ARqO vE retaHsicO” Sata॰ brA॰ । aRqena nirvfttaH aR । aRqanirvftte 5 kapAlarUpe dyuloke BUloke ca । “tasminnaRqe sa BagavAnuzitvA parivatsaram svayamevAtmano DyAnAttadaRqamakaroddviDA । tAByAM sa SakalAByAYca divaM BUmiYca nirmame iti” manunA'RqaSakalAByAM tayorutpattipratipAdanAttayostaTAtvam ।
m: आण्ड अम्, n. (fr. अण्ड), an egg, RV.; AV. &c.
आण्ड (औ), m. du. the testicles, AV. ix, 7, 13; VS. &c.

v: ARqaja

pu॰ aRqAt jAyate jana--qa svArTe aR । 1 aRqaje pakzisarpAdO । 2 tacCarIre na॰ “tezAM KalvezAM BUtAnAM trIRyeva vIjAni BavantyARqajaM jIvajamudBijjam” iti CA॰ u॰ । “tezAM jIvAvizwAnAM KalvezAM pakzyAdInAM BUtAnAmezAmiti pratyakzanirddeSAnnatu tejaH praBftInAm । tasmAttezAM KalvezAM BUtAnAM paSupakzisTAvarAdInAM trIRyeva nAtiriktAni vIjAni kAraRAni Bavanti । kAni tAnItyucyante । aRqajamaRqAjjAtam aRqajamevARqajaM pakzyAdi । pakzisarpAdiByo hi pakzisarpAdayo jAyamAnA dfSyante । tena pakzI pakziRAM vIjam sarpaH sarpARAM vIjam । taTA'nyadapyaRqAjjAtaM tajjAtIyAnAM vIjamityaryaH ॥ nanvaRqAjjAtamaRqajamucyate 'to'RqamevaM vIjamiti yuktaM kaTamARqajaM vIjamucyate । satyasevaM syAdyadi tvadicCAtantrA SrutiH syAtsvatantrA Srutiryata AhARqajAdyeva vIjaM nARqAdIti । dfSyate cARqajAdyaBAve tajjAtIyasantatyaBAvo nARqAdyaBAve । ato'RqajAdInyeva vIjAnyaRqajAdInAm” BA॰ ।
m: आण्ड—ज आण्ड-), mfn. (born from an egg, ChUp.; AitUp.
आण्ड—ज (अस्), m. a bird, Suparṇ.
आण्ड—कपाल n. an eggshell, ChUp.
आण्ड—कोश m. an egg, BhP.
आण्ड—कोश mfn. enclosed in an egg, BhP.
आण्ड—पीत (आण्ड-), mfn. one who has sipped eggs, TĀr.
आणुक or आणूक, n. dirt in the eye, L.
